description: Check whether a Czech entity is registered as a VAT payer (plátce DPH) based on ARES. Returns the IČ DPH (= DIČ) if active. NOTE: ARES reflects VAT-payer status with up to 24h delay; the authoritative source is MFČR (adisspr.mfcr.cz).

expectedDic.description: Optional DIČ to cross-check against ARES (e.g. 'CZ27074358'). Tool will report a mismatch.

name: ares_check_vat_payer
